About

Free Online Pool, Snooker & Billiards Practice Table

Set up a shot and practise it until you own it. Tailuge Billiards' free practice table lets you place every ball exactly where you want it, then play that shot as many times as you like — in the browser, with no download and no account.

Set up a shot

Drag any ball anywhere on the table, or start from a preset such as a break, a line-up or a grid. The cue ball and every object ball can be repositioned, so you can rebuild a break, a safety or a stubborn position you keep missing — for pool, snooker or carom layouts.

Play the layout

Hit Play to open the layout in the full 9-ball game exactly as you set it. Pot it or miss it, then return and play the same shot again — a repeatable drill rather than a fresh table each time.

Share the setup with someone else

Press Share to copy a link that carries your table setup. Anyone who opens it gets the same balls in the same positions, so you can hand out homework, compare approaches or challenge a friend to the same drill.

Prefer a ready-made course? The billiards skill tests, snooker skill tests and three-cushion skill tests open each shot here in the practice table. To play against someone, find a game in the lobby, or read the practice log on clearing the line-up.
